City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
August 6, 2012
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City Council Meeting held on July 16, 2012. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Minutes -July 16, 2012
c.
Approval of Demands
Staff Report -item 4.C.
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report -item 4.D
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report -item 4.E.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the public works department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report -item 4.F.
g.
Report presenting the Treasurer's Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 4.G.
h.
Recommendation to award contract for Construction Management and Inspection Services to Onward Engineering for the Crenshaw / Lomita Intersection and Street Improvement Project. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report -item 4.H.
i.
Recommendation to approve the purchase of 2013 Freightliner M2-106 California Air Resources Board (CARB) compliant clean diesel dump truck from Los Angeles Freightliner, in the amount of $109,940.00. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report -item 4.I
j.
Report submitting Final Acceptance of Pacific Coast Highway (PCH) water main replacement project and accepting the work performed by Los Angeles Engineering, Inc. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report -item 4.J
k.
Consideration of Councilmembers' Defense in Islamic Center of the South Bay, Los Angeles v. City of Lomita, et al.
PUBLIC HEARING:
Staff Report -item 4.K
5.
OVERSIZED VEHICLE ORDINANCE Introduction and consideration of an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita adding Article 3 (overnight parking of oversized vehicles) to Title VIII, Chapter 1 of the Lomita Municipal Code.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
Staff Report -item 5
6.
CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (CMP) An annual review of the City of Lomita's conformance with the Congestion Management Program (CMP) for Los Angeles County and adoption of the CMP Local Development Report (LDR).
Presented by Assistant City Manager/Community Development Director Sugano.
Staff Report -item 6
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013 BUDGET AMENDMENT Discussion and possible consideration of proposed allocations from the revised general fund balance overage.
Presented by Administrative Services Director Chavez.
Staff Report -item 7
8.
CYPRESS WATER PRODUCTION FACILITY (CWPF) OFFLINE TESTING RECOMMENDATIONS Discussion and possible consideration to proceed with Offline testing at the Cypress Water Production Facility and to establish goals and objectives for groundwater for Well #5.
Presented by Public Works Director Damasse.
Staff Report -item 8
CLOSED SESSION
9.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL?Existing Litigation Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(a)
Islamic Center of the South Bay v. City of Lomita, et al.
United States District Court LA CV12-02418
10.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - Anticipated Litigation Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(b)
Number of potential cases: 1
Letter from Steven H. Rosenbaum to City Attorney dated July 24, 2012
11.
ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
